parsed.name: 泰克系列波形采集功能模块
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件功能模块，用于面向泰克系列 MSO/示波器遍历仪器上的可用信号源，并读取对应波形数据，汇总为波形集合，便于实验中的波形抓取与后续分析。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software feature component for Tektronix series MSO/oscilloscope instruments. It iterates over available instrument sources, retrieves waveform data, and packages the results into a waveform collection for experimental waveform capture and downstream analysis.

actions.description: 自动遍历仪器上所有可用信号源并采集波形数据，返回波形集合。
actions.description_en: Automatically iterate through all available instrument sources and acquire waveform data, returning a waveform collection.
